rows.question: Three short things: when buying turns on, what share of the 500 dollar book goes to Bitcoin and to Ethereum, and is it bought at once or in steps? Can the book sell short or bet on a fall? Do you place real orders on NDAX with my money?
rows.answer: Evening, sir. When the dial opens, Bitcoin gets 40% of the book and Ethereum 20%, so 60% in the core. It's bought all at once, and all of it is sold when the dial closes. The thirds-in-steps version from 24 Oct failed review 39 and has been off since 10 Nov. No, the book can't sell short or bet on a fall. It's spot buying only, and when the dial is closed the core just sits in cash. No, I don't place real orders on NDAX. It's all paper, no exchange is connected, and real orders only come after your live rules are written and approved.
